objective: Depict Caelen's transition into the void, his processing of death, and the initialization of the System with dual-path progression.
intendedChange: Caelen stabilizes in the void, accepts his death, and recognizes his unique status as a System bearer with Dominion Level 1 and Sacrifice Level 1.
prohibitedPatterns: Do not introduce a confrontation, revelation, larger replacement threat, arrival, pursuit, interruption, or cliffhanger merely to make the chapter seem eventful.
Do not require comrades to die, scatter, betray one another, or lose competence merely to isolate the viewpoint character for a decision.
Do not create cosmetic variations of the same search, discussion, ritual, journey step, discovery, or confrontation.
Do not fill the schema's maximum string length or stop in the middle of a sentence.
Do not designate a final scene.
Do not pull objectives, milestones, or resolution work forward from later sibling arcs.
Do not introduce, perform, summarize, reveal, or resolve that work merely to fill scenes or create an ending.
Do not claim that it occurred unless the generated chapter actually establishes it.
Do not copy the failed sequence or treat its prose as accepted story history.
Do not rush into later plot events.
Do not use one-word narrative sentences or fragments for dramatic emphasis.
Do not use contrast phrasing as a routine device for emphasis, description, atmosphere, or emotional interpretation.

scenes.purpose: Establish the sensory and emotional nature of the void as Caelen's consciousness detaches from his dying body, processing the immediate trauma and confusion of his death.
scenes.intendedChange: Caelen transitions from the physical pain of his fatal wounds to a state of suspended animation in the void, where his memories of the battlefield begin to soften and his identity starts to fragment.

scenes.purpose: Depict Caelen's internal struggle to reconcile his self-image as a selfish Marine with the reality of his sacrificial act, leading to the sudden initialization of the System interface.
scenes.intendedChange: Caelen confronts the cognitive dissonance of his final choice, and the System manifests as a private, neutral interface, revealing his dual-path progression for the first time.

scenes.purpose: Show Caelen exploring the System's basic rules and his unique status, accepting his death and the reality of his new state as a soul in the void.
scenes.intendedChange: Caelen stabilizes his consciousness in the void, understands the concept of levels and his dual-path progression (Dominion Level 1, Sacrifice Level 1), and chooses to engage with the System rather than resist it.
